hints.title: Dual Chronological and Extreme Ordering Coordination
hints.text: Coordinate a sequential chain recording insertion order with an ordered ranking structure tracking maximum values with efficient node deletion.

hints.title: Two-Way Node References with Soft Deletion
hints.text: Each node in the doubly linked chain contains an identifier. Keep a max-heap of (val, id, node). Mark popped nodes as deleted in both structures.

hints.title: MaxStack Blueprint
hints.text: In push(x): append node to tail of doubly linked list, push (-x, -id, node) to heap. In pop(): remove tail node, record deleted id, return node.val. In popMax(): pop heap until top node not deleted, unlink node from doubly linked chain, record deleted id, return val.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Node:
    def __init__(self, val, nid):
        self.val = val
        self.id = nid
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class MaxStack:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = Node(0, 0)
        self.tail = Node(0, 0)
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head
        self.heap = []
        self.deleted = set()
        self.id_counter = 0

    def push(self, x: int) -> None:
        self.id_counter += 1
        node = Node(x, self.id_counter)
        pred = self.tail.prev
        pred.next = node
        node.prev = pred
        node.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = node
        heapq.heappush(self.heap, (-x, -self.id_counter, node))

    def _clean_tail(self):
        while self.tail.prev != self.head and self.tail.prev.id in self.deleted:
            node = self.tail.prev
            node.prev.next = self.tail
            self.tail.prev = node.prev

    def pop(self) -> int:
        self._clean_tail()
        node = self.tail.prev
        node.prev.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = node.prev
        self.deleted.add(node.id)
        return node.val

    def top(self) -> int:
        self._clean_tail()
        return self.tail.prev.val

    def _clean_heap(self):
        while self.heap and -self.heap[0][1] in self.deleted:
            heapq.heappop(self.heap)

    def peekMax(self) -> int:
        self._clean_heap()
        return -self.heap[0][0]

    def popMax(self) -> int:
        self._clean_heap()
        neg_val, neg_id, node = heapq.heappop(self.heap)
        nid = -neg_id
        self.deleted.add(nid)
        node.prev.next = node.next
        node.next.prev = node.prev
        return -neg_val
```

complexity.time: O(log N) push/popMax, O(1) top/peekMax amortized
complexity.notes: Doubly linked list allows O(1) node deletion; heap allows O(log N) maximum element retrieval.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A single stack requires O(N) auxiliary stack transfers to extract the maximum element.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual data structures and deletion tombstone set maintain synchronized state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of doubly linked list plus balanced BST or heap with lazy tombstone deletion.
